name: Typeform
why_interesting: Pioneered the conversational form experience with one-question-at-a-time interface
Dramatically higher completion rates (up to 3x) compared to traditional forms through reduced cognitive load
Beautiful, customizable themes transform utilitarian data collection into branded experiences
Logic jumps and branching create personalized, adaptive form journeys
Keyboard-first navigation makes form completion feel like a conversation, not a task
Progress indicators and smooth transitions reduce form abandonment anxiety
Rich media integration (videos, images, GIFs) makes forms engaging rather than boring
Question types designed for specific data needs while maintaining conversational flow
Analytics dashboard provides actionable insights beyond raw response data
Seamless integrations turn form responses into workflows across business tools

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: One-question-at-a-time conversational UX that prioritizes respondent experience over form builder convenience

business_model.free_tier: 10 questions per form, 10 responses/month, basic themes
business_model.basic_tier: Basic - $25/month - Unlimited questions/responses, file uploads, payment collection
business_model.plus_tier: Plus - $50/month - Logic jumps, calculator, hidden fields, custom branding
business_model.business_tier: Business - $83/month - Drop-off analytics, priority support, advanced integrations
business_model.enterprise_tier: Enterprise - Custom pricing - SSO, dedicated success manager, custom contracts

notable_ux_innovations: One question at a time display paradigm
Welcome and ending screens for branded experience
Question piping (dynamic text based on previous answers)
Conversational tone in default question copy
